assumptions: USD million. Fictional Copper Ward. Toy distinct capitation, fee-for-service and restricted grant; no overlapping costs or patients in models. No tax.

evidence.text: [Capitation] 25k members at $180/month, full year. All membership service earned; collections50m, opening capitation AR3m. Covered clinical costs42m.
[Fee service] 50k completed visits at net $300/visit after contractual discounts; cash14m, opening AR2m. Direct visit cost9m.
[Grant] Restricted research grant cash12m, verified eligible expense8m, both recognized earned8 and expense8. Unspent4 refundable liability. Ineligible expense1m from general cash.
[Common] Central expense10m including noncash depreciation2m, interest3m. No other costs. All current costs paid cash except depreciation; capitation cash costs40m instead of42m.
[Cash] Opening unrestricted cash8m, restricted grant cash zero. Equipment capex6m, debt draw5m, principal repayment2m. Research restricted eligible costs8 paid from grant; no other flows.
[Policy] CFO includes grant receipts/payments; unrestricted operating cash excludes restricted grant activity. No grant offset against ordinary service expense. Loan minimum unrestricted cash10m.
[Deck] Counts all grant12 as earned and unrestricted, uses aggregate revenue per visit with member-months mixed; adds capitation billings to cash received.

qas.question: Tổng member-months thuộc hợp đồng capitation?

Tổng doanh thu dịch vụ y tế, chưa tính grant?
Phần tài trợ nghiên cứu earned năm nay?
Nghĩa vụ hoàn tài trợ còn lại?
Tổng operating revenue cả dịch vụ và earned grant?
EBIT sau clinical, research và central expenses?
PBT sau interest3?
CFO unrestricted từ actual service receipts and cash costs?
CFO toàn đơn vị gồm grant cash activity?
qas.answer: CFO unrestricted = 50+14−40−9−1−(10−2)−3 = 3 triệu USD. Hoạt động grant có thu12 và chi8, đều thuộc CFO theo chính sách. CFO toàn đơn vị = 3+12−8 = 7 triệu USD.

qas.question: Closing unrestricted cash sau capex và debt flows?
qas.answer: CFO không hạn chế = 50+14−40−9−1−8−3 = 3 triệu USD. Tiền cuối kỳ không hạn chế = 8+3−6+5−2 = 8 triệu USD, thấp hơn mức sàn10 là 2 triệu USD.

qas.question: Closing total cash gồm restricted grant dư?
qas.answer: CFO không hạn chế = 50+14−40−9−1−8−3 = 3. Tiền không hạn chế cuối kỳ = 8+3−6+5−2 = 8; grant hạn chế còn 12−8 = 4. Tổng tiền cuối kỳ = 12 triệu USD.

qas.question: Có kết luận cash floor đạt vì total12>10?
qas.answer: Không. Covenant yêu cầu unrestricted8, thiếu2; grant dư4 restricted/refundable.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Willow Freight. Toy road freight principal and customs broker agent; lease liability and factoring borrowing explicit.

evidence.text: [Road] Earned freight220m, customer receipts210m, opening AR18m. No writeoffs. Direct expense140m excluding D&A/lease interest.
[Broker] Collects customs funds60m, earns commission9m, remits46m to authorities, opening agency payable4m. No other brokerage revenue.
[Lease] Opening ROU100m and liability120m. New lease ROU/liability40m noncash, annual depreciation20m, interest8m, cash lease payments30m. No remeasurement.
[Factoring] Full recourse advance25m against receivables, no derecognition. Fee1m cash expensed separately. No repayment. Opening other bank debt70m, new bank loan15m, repay10m.
[Other cost] Central expense35m, brokerage expense4m, owned PPE depreciation5m, bank interest4m. No tax.
[Cash] Direct road cash paid135m, central35m, brokerage4m, bank interest4m, factoring fee1m. Lease interest CFO and principal CFF. Cash owned PPE capex18m. Opening cash20m. No other flows.
[Policy] Group revenue road+commission; gross debt includes bank, factor, lease. FCF after leases=CFO−cash capex−lease principal. Agency gross cash flows operating under toy.

FCF before lease principal under cash capex metric?
qas.answer: CFO = 210+60−46−135−35−4−4−1−8 = 37 triệu USD (bao gồm dòng tiền đại lý và lãi thuê theo quy ước). Trừ cash capex18: FCF trước trả gốc thuê = 19 triệu USD.

qas.question: FCF after leases under disclosed metric?
qas.answer: CFO = 210+60−46−135−35−4−4−1−8 = 37. Trừ capex18 và gốc thuê 30−8 = 22: FCF sau thuê = −3 triệu USD.

qas.question: Closing cash after factor advance, bank flows and after-lease FCF?
qas.answer: CFO = 210+60−46−135−35−4−4−1−8 = 37. FCF sau thuê = 37−18−(30−8) = −3. Tiền cuối kỳ = 20−3+25+15−10 = 47 triệu USD; khoản factor được ghi là vay.

qas.question: Vì sao factor advance25 không làm customer AR giảm?
qas.answer: Full recourse classification là secured borrowing; no derecognition, cash financing separate.

qas.question: Có dùng customs collections60 làm own sales và remittance46 làm COGS?
qas.answer: Không. Customs agent earns9 commission; seller/authority funds settle payable, not own revenue/cost.

assumptions: USD million; million ASK/RPK and liters. Fictional Silver Tern Air. Toy ticket cash liability, loyalty allocation, realized fuel hedge and cash flow.

evidence.text: [Traffic] Domestic ASK900/RPK720, yield$.15/RPK. International ASK1100/RPK770, yield$.20/RPK. Fare revenue equals ordinary ticket service earned, excludes loyalty releases.
[Tickets] Opening ordinary ticket liability50, loyalty liability20. Current passenger ticket cash300, allocate270 ordinary and30 points. Ordinary cash refunds8; all refund from ordinary liability.
[Loyalty] Partner bank cash15 for points; loyalty redemptions release32, verified expiry3. No separate cash receipts on release. Fulfillment cost12.
[Other] Cargo revenue40, ancillary20, all cash collected. Fuel consumption120m liters at $.8, realized hedge cash gain10 reducing fuel expense. OCI unrealized hedge loss5, not P&L.
[Costs] Crew70, aircraft rent30, maintenance25, other cash-type opex45, D&A20, interest12. No tax. Ordinary fuel cost and loyalty cost separate.
[Cash] All operating costs paid except D&A and other cash-type cost actual42 not45. Cash capex35, opening cash25, borrowing40, principal repay15. No other cash flow.
